lines.text: A person who wakes up early.
My dad is an early bird.

data.mean: A person who wakes up early.
data.define: Someone who likes to get up and start early.

example.text: My dad is an early bird.

misuse.text: Don't call a late sleeper an 'early bird'.
misuse.why: It means someone who wakes early.
